Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> In Focus | National CEO Network Ghana congratulates Abena Amoah, Salem Kalmoni on CIMG awards Source : Myjoyonline.com 18 October 2026 4:49pm Audio By Carbonatix
CEO Network Ghana has congratulated Chief Abena Amoah of the Ghana Stock Exchange (GSE) and Chief Salem Kalmoni of Japan Motors for being named Marketing Woman and Marketing Man of the Year, respectively, at the 2025 CIMG Marketing Performance Awards.
The network said the recognition of the two executives reflected their leadership, innovation and professional excellence.
It described Chief Abena Amoah and Chief Salem Kalmoni as proud members of the network whose achievements had contributed to Ghana’s corporate landscape.
“CEO Network Ghana celebrates your success and commends your contributions to Ghana’s corporate landscape,” the organisation said in a congratulatory message.
The network said the awards demonstrated the value of excellence and leadership in Ghana’s business community.
It wished both executives continued success in their respective fields.
CEO Network Ghana describes itself as an organisation focused on connecting leaders, enabling business and contributing to Ghana’s transformation.
